contents.content: There are 10-15 questions. There is no time limit.

_data.content:
This test will check what you have learned in this lesson.
  • Ask for confirmation.
  • Discuss hypothetical situations in the past.
  • Discuss future plans.
  • Discuss what-clauses and long noun phrases as subjects.
  • Report what someone had previously said.
